metadata.title: Clicked like I owed someone money and somehow got 2 clueless kills? Valorant just broke again
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like my mouse had a mind of its own.
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure confusion.
Pretending I meant that for a hot 0.14 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a glorious mess but kills still sneak in!

Tap if your aim’s chaotic but the kills still roll in!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
